View more projects Roofing We Provide in Lewisville Complete Roofing Solutions for Every Need Our Lewisville team specializes in comprehensive roofing designed to protect your home from Texas weather extremes. We handle new roof installation for custom homes and renovations, ensuring proper ventilation and insulation that can reduce your cooling costs by up to 30%. Our roof replacement include complete tear-off and disposal, addressing underlying deck damage that 67% of Lewisville homes experience after 15+ years. For roof repair , we respond within 24 hours to storm damage, fixing everything from missing shingles to structural issues. Our restoration breathe new life into aging roofs, often extending their lifespan by 10-15 years at a fraction of replacement cost. We also provide preventive maintenance programs that catch small issues before they become $5,000+ problems, plus certified roof inspections for real estate transactions and insurance claims. Beyond traditional, we excel at spray foam insulation installation that creates an air-tight seal, reducing energy bills by an average of $2,400 annually for our Lewisville clients. Whether you need specialty roofing for flat commercial structures or architectural shingles for your dream home, our 128-member team has the expertise to deliver. Roofing Materials We Install in Lewisville Living in Lewisville means dealing with everything from 110°F summer heat to softball-sized hail. That’s why we’ve partnered with manufacturers whose products actually perform in North Texas conditions. Asphalt shingles remain our most popular choice, and for good reason. Modern architectural shingles from GAF and Owens Corning offer Class 4 impact resistance—that’s the highest rating available. We’re talking about shingles that survived the April 2021 hailstorm that devastated surrounding areas. With proper installation (and we’re Master Elite certified), these shingles carry 20-30 year warranties and resist winds up to 130 mph. The algae-resistant granules also combat the black streaking common in our humid climate. Metal roofing has exploded in popularity across Lewisville, especially standing seam systems. Why? They reflect up to 70% of solar heat, potentially cutting cooling costs by 40%. We install steel, aluminum, and copper systems with 30-50 year warranties. During last year’s heat dome when temperatures hit 118°F, our metal roof clients reported interior temperatures 15 degrees cooler than their neighbors. Plus, metal roofs laugh at hail—we’ve seen them take direct hits from baseball-sized hail with zero penetration. Clay and concrete tiles offer unmatched longevity in our climate. These materials naturally insulate, keeping homes cooler without cranking the AC. Boral tiles, our primary supplier, engineer their products specifically for Texas weather. With 50+ year warranties and virtually zero maintenance, tile roofs represent a true generational investment. We’ve replaced 30-year-old tile roofs that still looked new—they were only replaced for home renovations, not failure. We also work with slate (both natural and synthetic), wood shake for specific architectural styles, and commercial-grade single-ply membranes (TPO, PVC, EPDM) for flat roofs. Our partnerships with CertainTeed, Tamko, and other manufacturers ensure access to materials that match any architectural style or budget requirement. Don’t see exactly what you need? We maintain relationships with over 25 manufacturers and can source virtually any roofing material available in the U.S. market. Your satisfaction drives our commitment to finding the perfect solution. Meet Our Team The professionals you’ll meet aren’t just roofers—they’re your Lewisville neighbors who understand exactly what North Texas weather throws at our homes. With specialized training in everything from traditional shingle installation to cutting-edge Tesla solar integration, our local crews bring both expertise and genuine care to every roofing project. This is the actual team that will work on your home, backed by our company’s 26 years of excellence. Frequently Asked Questions About Roofing in Lewisville How do I know if my roof needs replacement after a Texas storm? Look for these red flags: missing or curled shingles, granules filling your gutters, water stains on ceilings, or daylight visible through roof boards. After major storms, we offer free inspections—better to catch damage early than face a $15,000 interior repair from hidden leaks. Insurance typically covers storm damage, and we work directly with adjusters to document everything properly. What roofing material handles Lewisville's climate best? It depends on your priorities. For pure durability against hail and wind, metal roofing wins hands-down. For best value, architectural asphalt shingles with impact resistance balance cost and performance. For energy efficiency and longevity, clay tiles excel but require stronger roof structure. We’ll assess your home’s specifics and recommend the optimal solution—there’s no one-size-fits-all answer. How long does a typical roof replacement take? Most Lewisville homes need 2-3 days for complete replacement. Day one: tear-off and deck repair. Day two: underlayment and shingle installation. Day three: flashing, ridge vents, and cleanup. Weather permitting, we’ve completed simple replacements in a single long day. Complex roofs with multiple valleys or specialty materials might need 4-5 days. We provide exact timelines during your consultation. Will you help with insurance claims? Absolutely. We document all storm damage with detailed photos and measurements that insurance companies require. Our project managers speak “insurance language” and ensure nothing gets missed. Last year alone, we helped Lewisville homeowners recover over $3.2 million in legitimate storm damage claims. We’ll meet adjusters on-site and advocate for full replacement when warranted. data.name: Roofing company in Lewisville | Excel Construction Group

reviews.text: Stephen Zertuche was outstanding! Excel Construction Group completed my roof replacement due to recent storms as well as, window screens, gutter replacements, and painting all trimming from garage door to front door. PUBLIC SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT….This was the most simple, smooth, and seamless process that I’ve ever experienced with a roofing contractor. Stephen took care of it all of the hassle including handling insurance. The work was completed very quickly and the material used was top notch. Stephen was very communicative and fully transparent from the beginning to the end of the project. I would highly recommend this company as well as Stephen for all of your roofing needs.
reviews.author: Brandon Byrd

reviews.text: Very happy with the quality of work, the timeliness, and cost.  Stephen was able to do the roof, replacement gutters and repair and paint the house under this insurance claim.  He must never sleep because he was always stopping by with samples and running off to the next client. We went over all the details of the work. If something wasn’t done to his standards, he made sure it was redone. He listened to what I wanted and checked with me throughout the process. Strongly recommend.
reviews.author: Carol MacGibbon

reviews.text:
Outstanding Roof Replacement Experience!
I recently had my roof replaced, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The crew was punctual, professional, and worked efficiently from start to finish. They kept the area clean, respected my property, and completed everything on time.  My home looks brand new!

I really appreciated the clear communication throughout the process; every question(100s of them ) I had was answered promptly and honestly. If you’re looking for a reliable and trustworthy roofing company, I highly recommend them — they truly go above and beyond!
Ask for LINDSEY LIGHTFOOT.
reviews.author: Mary Sandoval Velis

reviews.text:
Worked with Stephen on our home repairs.
He was very attentive and explained everything to us from start to finish. He worked with insurance company on items they missed so I didn’t have to. His working crew did all repairs promptly and professionally. Also we were very impressed by their clean up after work was completed. Every thing went smooth and professional and I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Kevin Preston

reviews.text: Excel Construction Group did an excellent job replacing the roof, downspouts, and gutters of our home at Walsh Ranch in Aledo. They were easy to work with and flexible. We specially liked working with their team’s manager Daniel Lopez, he was always professional and easy to work with.
reviews.author: M’cherie Vazquez

reviews.text: I definitely recommend this company. They did a fantastic job with our roof. I want to give a huge shoutout to Stephen for being a great guy. He came and explained their services and within a few days of agreeing on the services, everything was repaired and back to looking great! Very fast and efficient service!
reviews.author: Raju Lama

reviews.text: Luis Chavez from Excel Construction is dedicated to making sure that the job was done. Very pleased with the crew that replaced the roof as the also did an amazing job picking up after themselves. Yard was very clean professionalism. And considering all of the nails that must’ve been put to use and all of the work it takes to redo a roof, things were left in amazingly clean order once everything was done. He even helped me manage everything with my insurance company so even better! It was so good, Thanks Luis Chavez
reviews.author: Vicki Orlowski

reviews.text:
Honest, Professional, Quality Roofing Services.
I love my experience working with Excel Construction Group in West Fort Worth. Honestly! there were many roofers that came into my neighborhood due to the last storm but none of them convenced me at that time. Excel construction was referred to me though a family member. Samuel Reynolds was our guy, he reached out back pretty quick and gave us a good report of the overall damage in our home. Just by talking with him you know immediately that is someone you can trust and definitely represents the company well. Samuel answered every question we had and immediately  felt like he would exceeded our expectations. We'll I wasn't wrong! Samuel was very honest, upfront, walked me through the entire process and break it down (dumbed down) for us. When we agreed going with this company, I cannot day enough how happy we were with them. They provided us with a great quality work, he supervised the entire time and was monitoring the crew work every step of the way. Samuel also kept us informed throughout the entire process, and we felt pretty satisfied with the work we received. I highly recommend Samuel and this company for any kind of home project needed. Know that they are the one you can trust and they won't take advantage of you or your home insurance.
reviews.author: Angie Espindola

reviews.text: We worked with Stephen to replace our roof, gutters, garage door and fencing restained from hail damage. We found Stephen professional, knowledgeable and intuitive with color choices. The work was done to a very high standard and the crews were careful with our plants and the cleaned up was done promptly the same day! All said we have had great service, using quality materials and we have no hesitancy referring Mr. Zertuche!
reviews.author: John Hatridge

reviews.text: Hey everyone we moved down here a few years ago, and have not found a good contractor. When we had a bad hail storm back in April and really didn’t know who to use. Our friends gave us Stephen Zurtuche name and number. He took very good care of us! Our insurance only wanted to cover half of the rood to be replaced and Stephen took care of it with the insurance and we got a whole new roof, they took care of our fence and re staining everything, and added gutters around the house. I highly recommend this company and Stephen and personally wont use anyone else now with the experience that we had with them! When he says it will happen it happens if there is any problems he will take care of it right away!
reviews.author: thelabratms Lab rat

reviews.text: I worked with Steven Zertuche. I would definitely recommend him. He explained everything clearly and helped me keep my new roof within my budget. And he made the process very easy. A neighbor recommended him to me.
reviews.author: Alix Conte

reviews.text: My Excel rep, Lindsey L. (and her team), was incredibly efficient and professional when it came to the estimate, insurance interaction, install, and follow-up.  She communicated with me through every step and addressed each concern I had.  I would absolutely work with Lindsey and Excel again.
reviews.author: Justin Gregory

reviews.text: The company did the work quickly and sent pictures to let you know their work in progress. The company representative responds to me timely and offers help. The project manager that I had for my house is very professional. Overall it's a good company to work with.
reviews.author: Dandan Huang

reviews.text: This roofing company is above and beyond others! Very professional and easy to work with. Best experience I have ever had with a home repair. Would 100% recommend this company! Pete Chavez was a joy to deal with, went above and beyond to make sure I understood everything that was going to happen. I so appreciate his patience,!
reviews.author: Karen Lovell

reviews.text: Alex was very professional and very knowledgeable! Helped us through a stressful time in our lives. He definitely stood out from the other folks in the catastrophe business. Will Definitely recommend him to friends and family! Was a pleasure to work with!
reviews.author: darryl novak

reviews.text:
Stephen and Excel Construction Group has made my roof, window  fence & gutter replacement experience so smooth, easy and stress free. They have been very communicative and fully transparent from project start to finish. This group is 100% in the customer's corner by taking care of and hassling with your insurance to ensure you get all needing replaced taken care of with top notch materials. The crew that physically did all the repairs was very professional and proficient while completing the job - even clean up of old materials after the days work was done exceptionally well. Hands down recommended this group for any and all your roofing, window, fencing and gutter repairs.

- one happy and satisfied customer
reviews.author: Heather Robinson

reviews.text: Stephen came by my house and inspected my roof and found no damage. He was an honest guy and did a great job! Call him if you need your roof inspected!
reviews.author: Liz Dean

reviews.text: We dealt with Stephen Zertuche for this replacement. He was very persistent to start, but that spoke well to his professionalism and timeliness. He answered questions if I had them, available almost any time. They did a wonderful job and the roof looks great.
reviews.author: Terry Cellars
